instruction.text: Höre dir den Nachrichtenbeitrag vom 11. September 2001 an.

hint.text: Tippe den Lautsprecher unter dem Bild an, wenn du den TV-Bericht noch einmal hören willst.

atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>instrument-tubular-6</voice> <prosody rate='90%'><voice voiceLang='en' voice='m5Us'>It's September 11th, 2001. Welcome... to today's news. Today something terrible happened in New York. People were walking to work when at 8:46 a.m. they heard a plane flying way too low. Seconds later, this plane crashed into one of the world-famous twin towers of the World Trade Center. Just 17 minutes later, another plane crashed into the second tower. What was first thought of as a horrible accident turned out to be a planned terrorist attack. About half an hour later, a third plane crashed into a part of the Pentagon, the headquarters of the US Department of Defence in Washington D.C. The damage on the Twin Towers in New York was so massive that even the water sprinklers got damaged. It was impossible to stop the fires within the buildings. The steel construction beams became unstable and the two towers collapsed. Nearly 3000 people died during the attacks today.</voice></prosody>

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Text des Nachrichtensprechers, indem du die Lücken füllst.

atoms.text: During the attack on September 11th, there was a fourth plane that was hijacked by terrorists. This plane was also flying towards Washington D.C. where a plane crashed into parts of the Pentagon. The passengers on the plane called their families and told them what's happening. The families told them about the other attacks, and it became clear that this plane would also be used to kill people. The passengers on the plane tried to fight against the hijackers to get the plane under control again. This plane ended up crashing into a field close to Washington D.C. and all people on the plane died.

hint.sound: to hijack something or somebody <voice voiceLang='de' voice='m3'>bedeutet etwas oder jemanden entführen.</voice>

instruction.text: Bringe den Ablauf des 11. Septembers 2001 in die richtige Reihenfolge.

atoms.text: People saw a plane flying way too low in New York.
At 8:46 a.m., a plane crashed into one of the twin towers of the World Trade Center.
Shortly after, another plane crashed into the other tower of the World Trade Center.
At 9:37 a.m. another plane crashed into a part of the Pentagon in Washington D.C.
A fourth plane crashed into a field close to Washington D.C.

Each year, on the 11th of September, the USA remembers the people who were killed during the attacks in 2001. It's called “Patriot Day”. On that day, flags are put at half-staff to show that the country is mourning. Also, some people perform a moment of silence at the time when the first plane crashed into the World Trade Center.

hint.sound: half-staff <voice voiceLang='de' voice='m3'>bedeutet halbmast.</voice> to mourn <voice voiceLang='de' voice='m3'>bedeutet trauern.</voice>
